title: attributeInfo
description: List of attributes included for this layer.

key.description: Represents the attribute key. Key is the same as `id' used in the resource URL to fetch the binary buffers.

name.description: The attribute name. Must be unique for this layer.

ordering.description: Mapping between attribute to point. Only 1-to-1 is currently supported. Possible values for each array string: `attributeValues`

encoding.description: Encoding (i.e. compression) for the attribute binary buffer if different from GZIP or no-compression. Possible values are: `embedded-elevation`: No binary buffer but stats for this pseudo attribute will be available. For example, point.z from the geometry should be used. `lepcc-intensity`: LEPCC compression for scaled integral type. `lepcc-rgb`: LEPCC color compression for 3-channel RGB 8 bit.

attributeValues.description: Represents the description for value encoding, for example scalar or vector encoding.
